Hi Samantha,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood and requesting a demo — really excited to learn about what Grocerly is building. I'm Ben from our growth team; Marissa (cc'd) will join the call from the AE side. Before we lock a slot I have three quick questions so we can tailor the session: 

1) Primary use case — what features are most important (customer support summaries, search & recommendations, checkout chat, embeddings for search, etc.)?
2) Expected volume — ballpark daily/weekly requests and any peak QPS you expect (helps me recommend model/throughput).
3) Timeline & evaluation criteria — are you aiming to pilot this in the next month, quarter, or later? Any must-have security/compliance constraints?

- Tue 9/21 — 10:00–10:30am PT

- Thu 9/23 — 11:00–11:30am PT

Or pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?month=2026-09

Attaching a short demo agenda and a sample integration checklist so you can see what we'll cover. If you can reply with the three quick answers above, we'll tailor the demo to Grocerly's needs.

Thanks — Ben

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick follow up and for the attachments. Answers below: 

1) Use case: customer support automation (triage + suggested replies) and product search relevance improvements using embeddings. We may also pilot a checkout assistant later.
2) Volume: current traffic is modest — ~12k user interactions/month across web + app. Peak business day QPS ~6–8 for chat-style requests; typical steady-state QPS under 2. We expect volume to grow ~2–3x during holiday and promotions.
3) Timeline: hoping to run a short internal POC in the next 4–6 weeks and decide on a production timeline by end of Q4. Security: SOC2 is important; we also need data retention options and VPC/private deployment for production.

We can do Wed 9/22 at 1:00pm PT (your slot) — Raj (cc) will join as our engineering lead. Let me know if you need anything else before then.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Product, Grocerly
